## Ruling: C · 2026-11-02T06:21Z

The seat asked: 「选 C 还是 A？我推荐 C。」 C was stated as: 做个人视图，第一版排在四张卫生卡之后，范围按卡上写的. The maintainer: 「同意」.

**Ruled, with the sub-questions in the same stroke:**

- Named personal views are a user-owned data object. They are not view items and do not reuse `scope: 'personal'`.
- The first version is: save as my view, a 「我的视图」 group in the switcher, rename, delete, set as my default. Not in it: sharing and team views, admin management, a field picker, packaging and export.
- It follows #28949, #28948, #28950 and #28912. #28915 is not coupled to it.
- A personal view's id does not use the object.key view syntax. No unnamed preference layer sits on top of a personal view.

**Executed now:**

- #29037 retires the two inert `personal` declarations and corrects the docs line.
- #29038 records the ruling in ADR-0131 D13 and ADR-0017.
- `needs-user-decision` → `pm:blocked`.

**When all four blockers are closed,** the seat re-runs the re-checks above, measures whether the list filter panel can select a relative date such as 本周, and files the first-version execution card with the 「不包含」 list. An early unlock from any single blocker does not start it.

Sharing stays out until the first version has landed. It then needs usage evidence, and a ruling on whether non-admins may produce environment metadata.

epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

Premise measured · 2026-11-02T06:43Z. The maintainer asked the seat to finish what was unverified: 「没验证的 继续验证」. Preview: `bdb19ca6d9`, `examples/app-crm`, signed in as the dev admin.

**Relative dates: the engine works, and a reader has no way to choose one.**

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| REST `close_date < {today}` / `>= {today}` | 8 and 5 of 13 rows, correct dates, not inverted |
| REST `close_date < {week_end}` / `< {current_month_end}` | 8 and 9 rows, as the dates predict |
| REST `{not_a_macro}` | 400, "Unresolvable filter placeholder" |
| Console link with `uf__filter` value `{current_month_end}` (operator `before`) | The list requests the macro and shows 9 rows |
| Filter panel operators on a date field | 等于, 不等于, 为空, 不为空, 早于, 晚于, 介于. No relative option |
| Calendar 「今天」 | Stores `2026-11-02`, an absolute date, and it comes back from the stored preference on the next open |
| Typing `{today}` into the date input | Not applied. The filter keeps its previous value |

So the HotCRM comment at `src/sales/views/event.view.ts:17-23` ("date macros ship to the server as literal strings") doesn't hold on this build, while the one at `task.view.ts:298` does.

**What this means here.** A personal view saved today could only hold absolute dates, so 「我的本周跟进」 would go stale. The same is true of today's unnamed setting. Spec already has the presets (`DATE_RANGE_PRESETS`, including `this_week`) and the dashboard filter bar offers them. The list filter panel doesn't. The seat will bring this to the maintainer before the first-version card is filed.

**`Blocked-by` with four targets.** `h19BlockOutlivedBlocker` in `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` reports a row when any body target has closed. An open target "withholds a full discharge". `references/state-machine.md` says a closed upstream means re-deriving the block, never a reflex release. The "all targets closed" rule there applies only to the scheduled full-run card refresh. So one closure can raise a patrol row, and the remaining open targets keep this card blocked. The ruling comment's line, that an early unlock doesn't start the work, stands.

The seat's test filter was removed with 「重置视图」.
